name: Sylvan-Mausoleum
description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the north, impact-scarred wastelands. Nothing wears any of it smooth.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
Approach protocols for the pirate hideout are simple: announce once, dock slowly, compliment the cooking.
For traders, silicon, aluminum and uranium alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
